subject: system
statement: The system is one Windows desktop program written in Visual Basic .NET. Nearly all of its 12,570 program lines (92 files) sit in one folder, split between windows (screens) and policy-reading logic.

evidence.shows: One Windows executable project named Policy Plus, built on .NET Framework with Windows Forms.

statement: Policy Plus reads Windows policy definition files and shows their settings in a searchable tree, then reads or writes the policy values on a computer, a user account or a policy file.

evidence.shows: Opens the current user, all users or local machine registry areas as policy sources.
Parses policy definition XML files.

subject: system
statement: Developers build by opening the Visual Studio solution in Release mode, with version.bat stamping the git version into a source file. Separately, a GitHub workflow runs on every push to master (and on demand): it stamps the version, builds Release with MSBuild on a Windows server, prints the executable's hash (never compared to anything) and uploads the unsigned Policy Plus.exe to an Amazon S3 bucket as PolicyPlusLatest.exe, using stored AWS secrets through a third-party action (stcalica/s3-upload@0.0.1) and the old actions/checkout@v2. That bucket copy is what is distributed as the latest build. No test step exists.

evidence.shows: Triggers on push to master or manual run, builds, hashes and uploads the executable to S3 with AWS secrets.
Manual developer build in Visual Studio.
Writes the git description into a version source file.

subject: system
statement: In scope are 13,008 lines in 99 files: PolicyPlus holds 12,570 lines in 92 files, the root documents 355 in 5 and Docs 83 in 2. Left out as generated or not behaviour: 35 .resx screen-layout and text files (5,246 lines), the 8 files in My Project (425), LICENSE.txt (395), ATTRIBUTION.md (5), the generated Version.vb (4) and the build workflow latest.yml (40). The workflow is left out only because it is configuration, not program code; it is still cited here for how the program is published. Docs and the root Markdown files describe the program and its build and could be added to the Leave Out.

evidence.shows: Compile list of Visual Basic source files that make up the program.
.resx files are embedded resources for the screens.
My Project files are generated project plumbing.
Version.vb is an autogenerated file.

statement: The program targets .NET Framework 4.5.2, which no longer receives security fixes from Microsoft. Newer Windows still ships a compatible runtime, but the targeted version itself is out of support.

evidence.shows: Target framework is version 4.5.2.
Runtime configuration also pins 4.5.2.

externalSource.source: Microsoft support lifecycle: .NET Framework 4.5.2 support ended in April 2022

statement: The ADMX download feature fetches a Microsoft installer package over HTTPS with the .NET WebClient, unpacks it with Windows Installer (msiexec), and moves the files into the policy folder, with no check of the package's hash or signature.

evidence.shows: Downloads the MSI and runs msiexec on it without verifying it.
Fixed Microsoft download address naming one specific update.

statement: The program asks to run with the highest rights the signed-in user has. Access to policy data is decided by Windows, not by the program. When an administrator downloads policy files, the program enables ownership and restore privileges to take control of the destination folder.

evidence.shows: Requested execution level is highest available.
Takes ownership of destination when running as administrator.
Enables a named Windows privilege for the process.

statement: We go with the program running only on Windows desktops used by administrators, as a single copy started by a person, from a downloaded executable. No installer, service or schedule exists in the code.

assumed.why: No file states the intended audience or deployment; the code only shows a Windows executable.
assumed.ifWrong: If it must run on servers, unattended or on other operating systems, parts of the design would need to change.

evidence.shows: Output type is a Windows executable.
Multiple copies may run at once; started by a person.
Relies on Windows-only system calls.

statement: The download address and the folder inside the package are both pinned to one named release, Windows 11 Sep 2026 Update (26H2), on download.microsoft.com. If Microsoft moves or removes that file, or the folder name inside changes, the download feature fails until the code is edited; later Windows releases are not picked up.

evidence.shows: Fixed download link and package subfolder naming the Sep 2026 Update.
